messages:
Maria (Docs): quick sanity check — spotted a failing snippet in Optimize Toolkit docs (batching/caching section). sample uses legacy KV prefetch arg and CI is now red :grimacing:
AJ (Eng Docs): oof, link? I'll take a look in a few mins :eyes:
Maria (Docs): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 is the open PR that landed the example change, but local tests show the SDK expect `prefetch_kv` not `prefetch` so examples blow up on import. reproducer:
```python
# old example
client.optimize.run(model="redwood/fast-13b", prefetch=True, batch_policy="auto")

# updated SDK -> expected
client.optimize.run(model="redwood/fast-13b", prefetch_kv=64, batch_policy="auto")
```
Ben (ML): thanks for flagging — changing arg name could affect prefetch heuristics. If we switch to prefetch_kv=64 we should add a short note about "automatic sizing" for small sequence workloads. Will run a quick perf check against the sample corpus.
Sam (Product): we should also surface this in the migration guide (small blurb + table). customers hit this during migration to 0.8. :+1:
AJ (Eng Docs): i'll open a tiny follow-up PR that updates the snippet, adds a one-line migration callout, and fixes the sample-gen repo link (it points to master -> main mismatch). assigning myself.
Maria (Docs): thanks — can you link the PR here? i'll queue a docs review once CI is green. also add an SDK snippet variant for TS and python to keep parity.
AJ (Eng Docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1240 — changes: replace `prefetch` -> `prefetch_kv`, add migration note, add TS snippet. leaving a TODO to backport to localized pages.
DocBot: CI check failed on samples: sample-gen/tests/test_opt_examples.py::test_kv_prefetch — error: unexpected keyword argument 'prefetch' (TypeError)
AJ (Eng Docs): saw the CI failure, will push patch in a few. Ben — if your perf check suggests a different default kv size, i'll update the example and the note.
Ben (ML): quick run — for short sequences (<128 tokens) 32-64 works best. for long chat-like sequences 128 is safe. i'll paste numbers in the PR comments.
Maria (Docs): great — can we add a one-liner in the docs playground snippet that shows how to probe sequence distribution? e.g. `hist = analyze_sequences(corpus); recommend_prefetch_kv(hist)` — tiny helper. helps customers pick defaults.
Sam (Product): also add a short consumer-facing line in the console docs about the "KV prefetch" knob and cost impact. ops teams ask about token cost regressions when turning on kv caching.
AJ (Eng Docs): pushed fix -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1240/commits/aa7c3b9 — updated samples and migration note. CI re-run queued.
DocBot: CI passed on docs repo, sample-gen tests still flaky in ubuntu-20 runner (queue restart suggested).
Maria (Docs): nice. Ben, can you drop perf numbers in the PR and Sam please add the console blurb in the next sprint ticket? i'll track backport for localized pages. :thumbsup:
Ben (ML): will add numbers in the PR comments shortly.
Sam (Product): filing ticket: PROD-3581 — add console blurb & cost note.
AJ (Eng Docs): closing follow-up loop: once PR merged i'll run a quick search across docs for `prefetch=` and open small fixes for leftovers. anyone see other places?
Maria (Docs): did a grep locally, found one more example in `examples/edge-cases.md` — i'll include that in the PR.
Sam (Product): great, thanks everyone. leaving this thread here. :rocket:
